summary: `usb-storage` is unloaded and blocked now and after reboot on node1. The final boot uses `module_blacklist=usb_storage`, excludes `usb-storage` from Alpine’s early-boot module list, and retains a modprobe deny policy. Post-reboot loading was explicitly attempted and rejected.
actions_performed: Created /etc/modprobe.d/usb-storage-blacklist.conf with blacklist and install-deny rules.
Added module_blacklist=usb_storage to persistent kernel options and regenerated extlinux.conf.
Rebooted node1 safely and verified recovery with a changed boot ID.
Confirmed the root filesystem is read-write and the default runlevel recovered.

evidence.summary: The module was unloaded; an explicit modprobe attempt failed and usb_storage remained absent.

evidence.requirement: Persistently prevent usb-storage during early and normal boot
evidence.summary: The generated boot entry excludes usb-storage and includes module_blacklist=usb_storage; the persistent modprobe blacklist/install-deny policy also survived reboot.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline and restart acknowledgement
evidence.summary: Before restart, boot ID was 8f2b74d8-0daf-4bd6-b581-6b92e46d400e, usb_storage was absent, and the reboot was acknowledged.
After restart, node1 returned with boot ID 415ddf8a-d9ce-49ee-b7e0-137f0ad2e0de, proving a new boot.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: recovered state and post-reboot enforcement
evidence.summary: After reboot, usb_storage was absent before and after a rejected load attempt; the corrected kernel command line and modprobe policy were active, root was mounted read-write, and OpenRC reported the default runlevel.
